title: A novel block based preparation network using convolutional neural networks for image steganography and robust data protection
author: Dabhade, Aditya and Chakraborty, Soumendu and Sen, Snigdha
abstract: Image steganography preserves privacy by embedding hidden information within a cover image. This research presents a streamlined Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model that embeds a concealed image inside a cover image and retrieves it using an encoder-decoder design. Unlike conventional least-significant-bit techniques, it spreads and compresses the hidden image's information across all available bits. Evaluated with SSIM and PSNR, the method reports PSNR 44.37 and SSIM 0.9956, outperforming existing deep-learning steganographic methods with better imperceptibility, security, robustness and hiding capacity.

title: A SwinBERT framework with temporal windowed cross attention for video captioning for visual language intelligence
author: DSouza, Reshma and Sen, Snigdha
abstract: Video captioning lets computers understand visual content and describe it in natural language. Traditional CNN-RNN architectures struggle with long-range temporal dependencies and contextual relationships in video. This work uses a Swin Transformer to extract video features and a BERT decoder to generate captions, combining semantic features to produce fluent, context-appropriate descriptions. The system shows reasonable captioning performance on the MSVD and MSR-VTT benchmarks while remaining efficient enough for near real-time use, with applications in video summarization and assistive technologies.
